value.name: Crack and separate a hard casing
value.function: Crack the hard casing of your own shelled material, such as hazelnuts, in 0.1 blocks with controlled impacts of your own hard blunt striker on a stable support, and take the loose casing off opened blocks by hand to separate the kernel.
value.costs: Study: 3 rounds. target: your own unreserved, untreated item of a material with a represented casing (closed for crack modes, cracked unseparated for separate); quantity: exact tenths, 0.1-1 (default all, up to 1), reserved in one work (workId). Crack modes need striker (your own whole, rigid, sound inedible piece, e.g. a stone) and support (a solid inedible object in reach, not a plant or animal, or another own piece on firm ground), pinned for the work. Per 0.1 block: one cracking round, 1 energy; in crack-and-separate a block that opens adds one separation round, 0.5 energy; separate: one hand round, 0.5 energy per block. 0.9 units: at most 18 rounds, 13.5 energy. quoteOnly true reports quantity, striker condition, phases, maximum energy and wear bounds at no cost. pause, resume, cancel: one round, no energy. Checks run before any charge; failed rechecks pause open work at no charge. Travel and getting a striker are separate actions.
value.effects: Strength is hardness / 10; an impact passes the lower of striker and support strength x (1 - flexibility). At or below the casing strength the casing is unchanged: a real paid result that ends the work, the material returns as it was. Above it a block gains damage (load - strength) / strength: below 1 closed and damaged (a reattempt is new work), at 1 fractured open. Separation takes an opened block apart into 0.1 loose kernel and 0.1 casing fragments (a unit of each is that part of one whole unit) with the source origin, age and decay; the kernel carries all food value and toxicity, whatever they are. Opened blocks not separated stay cracked unseparated material. Wear: a striker no harder than what it strikes, or a support softer by 0.5 than what presses on it, loses 0.0001 kg per contact. Cancel returns reserved material as it now is; death leaves it at the worksite. Nothing is refunded, made safe or eaten; edibility, nutrition and toxins stay unknown; no reward.

execution.progress: One phase per paid round; the work, reserved material, damage, products and pinned striker and support persist; the same action continues it, resume restarts a pause after rechecks.
